v0.4:
Optional ESP32-S2 WiFi devboard support: hunting in a busy area triggers a
"signal storm" with an animated radar screen, boosted odds, a guaranteed floor,
WiFi-themed names, and an exclusive collectible "storm egg". Forage cooldown
shortened to 90s and made visible in the menu. Plays fully without the board.

v0.3:
Expeditions: send the dragon on a timed offline trip (30m / 2h / 8h) that
returns with loot and a journey log. Real sub-GHz airwave sensing for hunting.

v0.2:
Hunt the airwaves: one-tap Forage yields prey, treasure or eggs. Hoard rank,
hatchery, and legacy heir-hatching on death. Inventory screen. UI/UX overhaul
with a calm main screen and a scrollable menu.

v0.1:
Dragon-raising virtual pet: care-driven branching evolution (white/grey/black),
hunger/happiness/health, poop/sickness/sleep/discipline, offline simulation,
and care-gated immortality. Fork of MrModd's Matagotchi (GPLv3).
